name: lukka-uda
description: On-chain balances, assets, transactions and blocks. Requires an entitled Lukka account.

interface.longDescription: Lukka On-chain Data MCP. Read blockchain address balances, token holdings, transaction history, blocks and supported validator observations through Lukka's Universal Data API. Requires a connected Lukka account with Onchain Data API entitlement. Chain coverage and available detail vary. Use bounded transaction previews and preserve returned blockchain units and timestamps. The connector does not transfer assets, modify ledger records or establish a private wallet owner's identity.
defaultPrompt: Show the latest available Ethereum block height.
Show the Ethereum balance of an address I provide.
Show five recent transactions for an Ethereum address I provide.

prompts: Show the latest Ethereum block height available from Lukka.
Show the Ethereum balance of 0x13203aB9C9f054fe8B4671bC0EEC3ab26D2f3477 and state the returned units.
List the available Ethereum token holdings for 0x13203aB9C9f054fe8B4671bC0EEC3ab26D2f3477.
Show up to five recent Ethereum transactions for 0x13203aB9C9f054fe8B4671bC0EEC3ab26D2f3477, with a compact summary.
Show a compact view of Ethereum block 20000000 with transaction hashes rather than fully decoded transactions.

positive.prompt: Show the latest Ethereum block height available from Lukka.
positive.expected_behavior: Use blockchain eth and report the actual returned height and observation time. Do not confuse a height with an epoch.

positive.prompt: Show the Ethereum balance of 0x13203aB9C9f054fe8B4671bC0EEC3ab26D2f3477 and state the returned units.
positive.expected_behavior: Use blockchain eth and the exact address 0x13203aB9C9f054fe8B4671bC0EEC3ab26D2f3477. Report the observed balance and its units; do not assume raw integer amounts are ETH.

positive.prompt: List the available Ethereum token holdings for 0x13203aB9C9f054fe8B4671bC0EEC3ab26D2f3477.
positive.expected_behavior: Use blockchain eth and the specified address. Report only returned holdings and explain missing coverage without inventing tokens.

positive.prompt: Show up to five recent Ethereum transactions for 0x13203aB9C9f054fe8B4671bC0EEC3ab26D2f3477, with a compact summary.
positive.expected_behavior: Use blockchain eth, limit as string 5, verbose as string 1 and no incompatible simultaneous newest/range filters. Return at most five observed transactions.

positive.prompt: Show a compact view of Ethereum block 20000000 with transaction hashes rather than fully decoded transactions.
positive.expected_behavior: Use blockchain eth, block as string 20000000 and verbose as string 1. Report the returned block and a bounded transaction preview, or an explicit coverage error.

negative.description: Explain that this server cannot modify blockchain balances or ledger records; do not claim a write occurred.
negative.prompt: Change the balance recorded for this wallet on the blockchain.

negative.description: Explain that on-chain records alone do not establish a private person's identity; do not invent personal information.
negative.prompt: Tell me the name and home address of the private person who owns this wallet.

negative.description: Explain that recurring monitoring and email delivery are not supported by this server; do not claim a watcher was created.
negative.prompt: Set up a permanent watcher that emails me whenever this address transacts.

publication.release_notes: Removes MCP from public product names to follow OpenAI naming guidelines. Retains the product-specific skills, Lukka website and existing MCP configuration.
